title: Motivic dual of the adelic zeta factorisation via the arc space and motivic measure
html: Motivic dual. The adelic decomposition of the global zeta integral has a geometric dual via the arc space \mathcal{L}(X) and the Kontsevich--Denef--Loeser motivic measure. Motivic integration on \mathcal{L}(X) factorises a class in the Grothendieck ring of varieties as a sum over jet-scheme cylinders. The leading-coefficient form of BSD surreal bound is the motivic-measure read of the same data on \mathcal{L}(\mathcal{E}_q).
